buyer_questions.question: Which exact Go2 configuration and region are being quoted?
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: one written and internally consistent configuration baseline

buyer_questions.question: Does the project need app operation, custom software, or both?
required_inputs: interfaces expected by the custom application
failure_tests: an app-visible function is not exposed through the expected SDK
the custom application cannot recover after restart
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: each required function mapped to an app, SDK, ROS 2 or integration interface

buyer_questions.question: Which control layer must the team access?
required_inputs: low-level joint control if genuinely required
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: approved control surface with an explicit safety boundary

buyer_questions.question: Is the primary delivery path C++, Python or ROS 2?
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: a reproducible build and launch from a clean machine

buyer_questions.question: What exact artifact and workflow does mapping mean?
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: versioned map and task artifacts plus repeatable recovery evidence

buyer_questions.question: Which payload, sensor and onboard compute are required?
required_evidence: route and runtime retest with the final payload
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: final-payload test on the representative route

buyer_questions.question: What happens when the network, sensor or service fails?
required_evidence: task resume, restart or cancellation rule
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: one pass/fail record per agreed failure mode

buyer_questions.question: Can another engineer reproduce the environment?
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: successful clean-machine deployment by a second operator

buyer_questions.question: What evidence counts as project acceptance?
required_evidence: timestamped command, state and fault logs
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: signed acceptance matrix with evidence locations

buyer_questions.question: Is the purchase for a robot body, development kit, PoC or complete operating workflow?
buyer_questions.acceptance_unit: quotation and statement of work using the same scope baseline
